IC1: female or male of 50 to 85 years old with a care giver
IC2: Mini Mental Status (MMS) test between 16 to 26 inclusive
IC3: Clinical Dementia Rating (CDR) test inferior or equal to 1
IC4: National Institute of Neurological and Communicative Disorders and Stroke / Alzheimer's Disease and Related Disorders Association (NINCDS/ADRDA) test positive for an Alzheimer's disease
IC5: Diagnostic and Statistical Manual of Mental Disorders, 4th Edition (DSM IV) test positive for dementia
